themes.title: Far-Right Election Contestation Following Brazilian Runoff Defeat
themes.blurb: Flávio Bolsonaro's departure for the United States following his electoral defeat to Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva has triggered significant cross-border turmoil. Right-wing figures continue to challenge the election results and allege political persecution, while partner administrations in Argentina and the US face diplomatic scrutiny over their involvement in facilitating his exile.

countries.name: 🇧🇷 Bolsonarismo / Partido Liberal
countries.note: Flávio Bolsonaro fled to Miami via Argentina, claiming political persecution, questioning election validity, and declaring himself the opposition leader from abroad.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Javier Milei's administration faces diplomatic tension with Brazil and internal fallout over its alleged role in aiding Flávio Bolsonaro's transit through Argentina.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Donald Trump and Secretary of State Marco Rubio face questioning regarding Flávio Bolsonaro's arrival in Florida during high-level diplomatic exchanges.

themes.title: Judicial Crackdowns and Surveillance Targeting the Far-Right
themes.blurb: European right-wing movements are framing state security surveillance, judicial oversight, and constitutional court disputes as political weaponization by ruling coalitions. Leaders in Poland, Germany, and France accuse incumbent governments of breaching democratic norms to suppress conservative opposition.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: President Karol Nawrocki and PiS politicians entered the Constitutional Tribunal during midnight clashes, accusing Donald Tusk's government of an unconstitutional takeover.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Courts reaffirmed domestic intelligence surveillance of state AfD chapters, alongside ongoing legal measures to restrict member weapons ownership and public roles.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Party leadership faces heightened legal exposure regarding election eligibility while managing data breaches and municipal restrictions.

themes.title: National Priority Rhetoric and Hardline Migration Demands
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across Western Europe are doubling down on hardline anti-immigration demands and 'national priority' welfare principles. Conservative leaders are leveraging legislative negotiations and public campaigns to force incumbent governments into stricter border controls and spending cuts for foreign nationals.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox conditioned regional budget agreements on tax cuts, reductions in international aid, and strict 'prioridad nacional' provisions.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Nigel Farage and party candidates highlight rising English Channel migrant arrivals, framing current border enforcement as a threat to national security.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: FrP champions stricter immigration and integration standards, pressing rival parties for a renewed cross-party policy compromise.

themes.title: Internal Coalition Friction Over Foreign Policy and Media Strategy
themes.blurb: Key right-wing coalitions are experiencing acute internal friction regarding foreign policy positioning, ideological definition, and campaign messaging. Disagreements over military assistance to Ukraine, relations with neighboring states, and core party identity are testing coalition cohesion.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Jimmie Åkesson intervened in a severe internal dispute regarding 'open Swedishness' versus ethnic nationalism while media affiliate Riks faces funding cuts.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Giorgia Meloni's commitment to Ukrainian military aid faces recurring opposition from Matteo Salvini's Lega, alongside local electoral disputes.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Javier Milei's party faces internal strain with Patricia Bullrich and PRO allies over diplomatic responses to Brazil's election and 2027 alliance terms.

themes.title: Populist Right Momentum Ahead of Elections
themes.blurb: Populist conservative parties in Europe and North America are mobilizing campaign networks and formalizing candidate slates for upcoming regional, municipal, and general elections. Parties are capitalizing on economic anxiety, public sector strain, and incumbent vulnerability to build electoral momentum.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox launched pre-campaign rallies and presented candidate slates across several provinces ahead of the November 29 general election.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Center-right coalition partners are negotiating local mayoral nominations in major municipalities while leveraging strong poll numbers.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Intense campaign maneuvering continues between Fidesz and the Tisza party as both mobilize around economic growth numbers and budget debates.
